product.title: Great Ocean Road Small-Group Eco Tour from Melbourne

description.text: In Melbourne, this small-group eco coach leaves selected city hotels for a full Great Ocean Road day covering Torquay, the Memorial Arch, Kennett River koala spotting, Apollo Bay, Mait's Rest, the Twelve Apostles, and Loch Ard Gorge. The published format is an early-start deluxe mini-coach rather than a later sunset timing or a reverse-order luxury bus. The format suits visitors who want a classic coastal and rainforest circuit without a Grampians hiking day. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Melbourne, and the itinerary stays on those Shipwreck Coast and Otway stops that define this outing rather than a Yarra Valley cellar-door afternoon.

highlights: Twelve Apostles and Loch Ard Gorge

start.description: Pickup is only available from the list of hotels provided upon checkout. Pickup is between 7am-8am depending on which hotel you selected.

end.description: Return to the Melbourne meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
